name: andrej-karpathy
tagline_zh: 调试深度学习管道总卡壳？让前特斯拉AI总监的思维模型帮你从零搭网络、评估Agent，像Karpathy一样直击本质。
tagline_en: Stuck debugging deep learning? Channel Karpathy's mental models to build nets from scratch, evaluate agents, and.
desc_en: Applies the mental models and frameworks of Andrej Karpathy (deep learning, former Director of AI at Tesla, founding member of OpenAI, Eureka Labs). Use this skill whenever you are helping the user build neural networks from scratch, debug deep learning pipelines, evaluate AI agent workflows, design LLM apps, or navigate the transition to Software 3.0 (vibe coding). why_zh: 同类技能只给步骤，它给的是Karpathy的决策框架——从第一性原理拆解问题，连vibe coding。
why_en: Unlike step-lists, it encodes Karpathy's first-principles decision framework, flagging vibe-coding pitfalls before you hit them.
unshelve_reason: 问二 · 同类聚簇审查（把 X 变成 skill（造 skill 工厂））。它不是一件被挑出来的单品，是生成器 K-Dense-AI/mimeo 的自动产物之一。feed 里它的 path 就写着 output/andrej-karpathy；该仓库 output/ 目录下共有 22 份同样自动生成的人物 skill（hinton / lecun / bengio / fei-fei-li / sutskever …）。同时它与 kaiming-he 是同一模板的两次填空——两份正文的章节骨架逐字相同（Core principles / How X reasons / Applying the frameworks / Anti-patterns … push against / Heuristics and rules of thumb / How to use this skill in conversation），references/ 文件名也完全一致（principles / mental-models / frameworks / anti-patterns / heuristics），结尾都写「不许扮演本人」。这与 D40 判死 archify 上游是同一形状的反面：那次是收了两代同一件东西，这次是从一个数量堆里抽了两件当单品。真正该过问二的是生成器本体 mimeo——它与女娲同轴（README：Clone an expert's way of thinking into your coding agent），但机制独占（Parallel Search 八类意图检索 + 引文逐条回原文核验、核不上的剔除并留 quote_verification.md 审计、对抗式评审迭代到 8 分才收）。 正文原话：**mimeo automates that project.** Point it at a name and it goes off and reads the internet on your behalf: surfaces the canonical sources, pulls full transcripts and articles, distills each one with a frontier model, clusters the recurring ideas across dozens of sources, and emits a production-ready artifact your agent can load.
